name: hue.tools · hue.tools

description.zh: 看Chinotto当前色块及多种实际格式数值。 hue.tools由pabueco发布，将混色、色值查询、叠色和调色集中到网页，Blend并列显示两色的混合结果，Info列出当前色彩空间数值。网页服务免费，自身程序按MIT许可公开，外部图像与输出使用范围另核。
description.en: hue.tools by pabueco offers color mixing, conversion, blending and adjustment. Blend displays results for two current colors; Info lists a color in multiple spaces and formats. The web service is free, while its own program is separately available under MIT. External images and output permissions have their own scope.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by hue.tools (https://hue.tools/).
Technology stack: svelte, typescript, tailwind.
Component specification: 看Chinotto当前色块及多种实际格式数值。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页看到Mix、Info、Blend、Modify四个入口。Blend当前用Nature与Warrior Queen两色，首排四种混合结果完整，下一排只见局部。Info另显示Chinotto的HEX、RGB等数值与外链入口，不能当成前两色的同次输出。此次未改色、复制或打开外链；免费网页与MIT程序分开核，外部图像和输出权限另查。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
